verdicts.reason: A keeps the full lockup intact (LUST/FOR box/WIN/dot row) with clear breathing room, but it reads as a shrunk copy: the type is small for the canvas, the corner × marks sit at arbitrary inset positions instead of the canvas corners, there are visible lighter vertical seams in the extended background at about x=170 and x=600, and the hand-wrap detail is cropped away. B makes the headline bold and dominant, but the WIN line and dot row are jammed against the bottom edge (the dot row is about 25px from the edge). The corner marks are gone and replaced by stray '× ×' fragments floating mid-height on both sides, and B has the same background seam bands.
